digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. Monday closed with the dashboard priorities still open, while direct email evidence confirms one completed payroll escalation and one firm project hold. Tomorrow is meeting-heavy and includes several overlaps that need early coverage decisions.

items.label: Raised the paystub withholding discrepancy with Payroll
items.detail: Jean sent Payroll a revision request after finding an ISR deduction of RD$46,194.98 on the latest paystub, materially higher than prior months.

items.label: Set the Amazon Connect UAT recovery decision
items.detail: Testing continued this afternoon, but the recovery path remains open. Validate routing and time-zone fixes, confirm ownership for number provisioning and spoofing, and decide whether UAT continues through Wednesday, September 2.

items.label: Prioritize Licelot's Quality project portfolio
items.detail: Rank the five named requests by business impact and set one intake path with realistic PM and PE capacity before work is assigned.

items.label: Close the remaining Amazon Connect migration-list gaps
items.detail: Confirm the remaining leaders, preserve the N/A plus Reporting guidance for non-calling users, and lock the production provisioning list.

items.label: Clear the stalled Sales and Revenue Cloud dependencies
items.detail: Confirm the Revenue Cloud owner, bring Deepak and Tim into the Sales Cloud work, secure an invoice record in sandbox, and set firm due dates.

items.label: Resolve the Sprint 17 capacity tradeoff
items.detail: Anu reported that EPMO projects already consume almost all available sprint capacity while Biographical deadline stories still need to be added. Confirm what will move or be reprioritized.

items.label: Limpiar Asana con el spreadsheet de Armando
items.detail: Reconcile Armando's spreadsheet against Asana, close stale entries, and leave one current operating view.

items.label: Decide Eduanny Suero's SOP access request
items.detail: Confirm the business need and appropriate permission for the Travel Permit client-contact SOP, then approve or decline the outstanding SharePoint request.

items.label: Clarify Licelot's Staff Aug document access and next step
items.detail: Licelot reported that she cannot access the shared Staff Aug Object-fields document and asked what action is expected from her. Restore access and answer the action-item question.

items.label: TRACE Minor Improvements is on hold pending support documents
items.detail: Mar told Yuri that implementation will remain paused until the required documents arrive, with a September 11 deadline before the request is closed.

items.label: 10:30 AM-noon - Jhara 1:1, SVC, and self-review training
items.detail: The Jhara 1:1 and SVC standup overlap at 10:30 AM. The English self-review training begins at 11:00 AM and is one of the offered live sessions.

items.label: Noon - PM working schedule discussion replaces the protected block
items.detail: Erin scheduled a PM working schedule meeting for noon, when the calendar still shows blocked space.

items.label: 1:00 PM - Knowledge Management and Case Management overlap
items.detail: The Knowledge Management EPMO alignment and Case Management CoE Process Overview start at the same time, so coverage needs to be assigned.

items.label: 2:00-4:00 PM - EPMO leadership and Nicolas follow-through
items.detail: Carry Monday's portfolio decisions into the 2:00 PM EPMO TL Weekly Catch Up and the 3:30 PM Nicolas 1:1.

items.label: 4:00 PM - Amazon UAT final session conflicts with CSC portfolio review
items.detail: Choose coverage in advance: the Amazon session is the final defect-submission window, while the CSC portfolio review begins at the same time.
